title: Our Mission
description: To make quality academic resources accessible to every Tribhuvan University student in Nepal — regardless of their financial situation. We believe education should be free and fair.

title: AI-Powered Learning
description: We use Google's Gemini AI to analyze past year question papers and predict what topics are most likely to appear in upcoming exams, giving you a strategic edge in your preparation.

title: Security First
description: All accounts are protected with secure HTTP-only cookies and email OTP verification. Premium content is protected against unauthorized screenshots and downloads.

title: Works Offline
description: TU Notes Hub is a Progressive Web App (PWA) — install it on your phone, tablet, or laptop and access your cached notes and papers even when you have no internet.
